# Pre-registration registry

Every pre-registration in this stage, and its outcome. Maintained by the **prereg-gatekeeper**
agent (`/prereg <title>`), which assigns the id and adds the row.

`propedge/backtest/harness.py` reads this file: a run whose `prereg_id` is not a row here, or
whose row's status is not one of `registered` / `open` / `running`, **raises**. There is no
override flag.

> **Every pre-registration must end with a recorded outcome — including the ones that failed.**
> A pre-registration with no outcome is an unreported result, and the closing checklist in
> `NEXT_STEPS.md` will not pass while one exists. A failed check is kept on record and
> diagnosed, never rerun until it passes (the failure protocol; propsim D-40).

## Status vocabulary

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `registered` | written, reviewed by the gatekeeper, not yet run. Runnable |
| `running` | a run is in progress. Runnable |
| `complete` | run, outcome recorded below. **Not** rerunnable |
| `abandoned` | not run; the reason is in the outcome column and in `DECISIONS.md` |
